name: repo-memory
description: Keep Claude Code's project-scoped auto-memory inside the git repo and sync it across every machine (laptop, cloud runners, ops boxes). A SessionStart hook redirects autoMemoryDirectory to the repo's canonical memory dir (worktree-safe) and pulls the latest; a Stop hook commits memory-only changes to the main branch and pushes. Memory travels with the repo via git instead of living machine-locally under ~/.claude/projects.
